نهرورق (form XII)
# نَهْرَوْرِقُ (nahrawriqu) /nah.raw.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
# نَهْرَوْرِقَ (nahrawriqa) /nah.raw.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
# نَهْرَوْرِقْ (nahrawriq) /nah.raw.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِهْرَوْرَقَ (ihrawraqa)
